about.title: About Me
about.name: Michael Oslizlo
about.intro: I'm Michael, a programming enthusiast from Podkarpacie, Poland. Born in October 2006, I'm currently studying computer science.
about.focus: I focus on web and application development, constantly expanding my knowledge and skills. I have passed both INF.03 and INF.04 qualifications (practical and theoretical exams). I find the greatest satisfaction in seeing the results of my work. I actively use AI tools as part of my workflow — it lets me deliver projects faster and more effectively, and this portfolio is exactly the proof of that.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy describes the rules for processing personal data of persons using the order form and other forms of contact on the verminew.github.io website.
privacy.puodoNote: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority — the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO):

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Michał Oślizło — a natural person conducting unregistered economic activity within the meaning of art. 5 sec. 1 of the Polish Act of 6 March 2018 — Entrepreneurs' Law.
Contact: {{adminEmail}}. The correspondence address is provided on request after a contract is concluded.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis of processing
paragraphs: Your data is processed for the following purposes:
list: Order fulfilment, preparing a quote and possibly concluding a contract for specific work — basis: art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (necessity to take steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract and to perform the contract).
Reply and correspondence handling — basis: art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest of the controller in providing a response).
Providing and securing the website — basis: art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Fulfilling tax and record-keeping obligations if a contract is concluded — basis: art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.

sections.title: Scope of processed data
paragraphs: The following data may be processed when you use the website:
list: First and last name (or company name)
E-mail address
Phone number (optional)
Inquiry content / project description
Attached files (if you choose to attach them)
IP address and technical request data processed by GitHub Pages hosting and the font provider

sections.title: Recipients of data
paragraphs: The form does not submit data automatically. Contact details and the project description reach an email provider only after you send the email yourself.
list: GitHub, Inc. — GitHub Pages hosting provider; logs visitor IP addresses for security purposes.
Google LLC — provider of the Google Fonts files used by the website interface.
Proton AG — the controller's email provider, based in Switzerland.

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: Correspondence data is stored for up to 12 months from last contact, then deleted.
Retention of technical data by external services is governed by the privacy statements of GitHub and Google.

If a contract is concluded, data necessary for accounting and tax purposes is stored for 5 years from the end of the calendar year in which the tax obligation arose (in accordance with the Polish Tax Ordinance).

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: In connection with the processing of your data, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access (art. 15 GDPR)
Right to rectification (art. 16 GDPR)
Right to erasure — "right to be forgotten" (art. 17 GDPR)
Right to restriction of processing (art. 18 GDPR)
Right to data portability (art. 20 GDPR)
Right to object to processing (art. 21 GDPR)
Right to withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent)

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: The app does not use its own advertising or analytics cookies.

Browser storage (localStorage / sessionStorage) is used solely to save your preferences (selected colour theme, interface language) and to temporarily store a partially filled order form so that you do not lose entered data on page refresh.
Data entered in the form stays in your browser and is not submitted automatically. It reaches me only after you download the generated package and send it yourself by email.
GitHub Pages hosting may process technical connection data under its own privacy statement.

sections.title: No profiling
paragraphs: Your data is not used for profiling or automated decision-making within the meaning of art. 22 GDPR.

questions.question: What types of projects do I prefer?
questions.answer: I'm most interested in projects involving web development, web applications, and AI-powered solutions. I'm open to educational projects and innovative solutions.

questions.question: How does the collaboration process work?
questions.answer: The process starts with an initial project discussion, establishing scope and timeline. Due to my studies, I prefer projects with flexible schedules.

questions.question: What technologies do I prefer?
questions.answer: I mainly work with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. I'm also interested in projects using Python, especially in AI-assisted contexts.

questions.question: Do I take commercial projects?
questions.answer: Yes, but selectively and in a limited capacity due to my studies. Each project is considered individually.
